displayName: [Preview]: Azure NetApp Files volumes should replicate only with volumes in allowed locations
description: Restrict the locations of Azure NetApp Files replication partners to meet data residency and sovereignty requirements. A volume in a replication relationship is non-compliant when the remote volume's region is outside the allowed replica locations, or when the volume is a replication destination outside the allowed replica locations. Volumes without replication are not evaluated. A source volume's own location is not evaluated.

metadata.description: The list of locations where Azure NetApp Files volume replicas and their replication partners are allowed.
Enable or disable the execution of the policy
